Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and Methods section is an affinity purification (AP-MS) survey to identify interaction partners of GPR35. The primary biological variable is the overexpression of GPR35 via cDNA transfection in HEK293T cells, compared against mock-transfected or tag-only controls. While the broader paper discusses Gpr35 knockout mice and T108M mutations, those were analyzed via Western Blot, ICP-MS, and other assays, not the tandem MS proteomics survey.
